payload.summary: COUNTER (codex, quoted). Verdict AGREE with an added requirement. Attack: 'The 90px stand-off is only emergent; a later change to #row-hands tracks or gap could break it without any named contract.' Verdict: 'Do not add --hand-standoff; add a pure geometry helper that computes the centre line and both inner-edge offsets from divider width, gap, and symmetric side tracks, then assert equality rather than 90.' Why: 'A token would duplicate a value already determined by 132px / 2 + 24px. The test is real only if it recomputes the offsets and separately guards the symmetric 1fr | 132px | 1fr topology.' The added requirement is the second guard: the arithmetic test proves symmetry GIVEN symmetric tracks, so the topology itself needs its own CSS-text assertion or the proof is circular.
